_comment: Curated notes for the tool inventory. Everything MEASURABLE is measured at build
time by build_page.py -- the directories in the image, the org's forks and their
parents, the upstream tool metadata. This file holds only what measurement cannot
answer: what a tool is for, whether our flow uses it, and why not if it does not.
Keeping the two apart is the point. A pasted count goes stale silently; a judgement
cannot be derived at all. So the generator joins them and REPORTS every divergence:
a directory in the image with no note here, and a note here for a directory that no
longer exists. Neither is allowed to render as a normal row.

bin.desc_zh: 共用 PATH 目錄（非工具）

covered.reason_en: Verilog coverage. We use verilator coverage, which we do ship.
covered.reason_zh: Verilog 覆蓋率；我們用 verilator coverage（已用）

cvc_rv.desc_zh: C 對 RTL 等價驗證
cvc_rv.reason_en: C-to-RTL equivalence. We have no C reference model; equivalence runs through yosys equiv.
cvc_rv.reason_zh: C 對 RTL 等價；我們沒有 C 參考模型，等價用 yosys equiv

fpga.desc_en: FPGA vendor-tool shim (not a tool dir)

gaw3-xschem.reason_en: GUI. The fleet is headless; waveforms are read programmatically by cocotb/verilator.
gaw3-xschem.reason_zh: GUI；fleet 是 headless，波形由 cocotb/verilator 程式化判讀

gds3d.reason_en: GUI viewer. GDS correctness is established by KLayout DRC plus geometric assertions, not by looking at it.
gds3d.reason_zh: GUI 檢視；GDS 正確性由 KLayout DRC + 幾何斷言證明，不靠目視

ghdl.reason_en: The flow's input is Verilog/SystemVerilog; there are no VHDL sources.
ghdl.reason_zh: 流程輸入是 Verilog/SystemVerilog，無 VHDL 來源

ghdl-yosys-plugin.reason_en: Same reason: there is no VHDL to feed yosys.
ghdl-yosys-plugin.reason_zh: 同上 —— 沒有 VHDL 要餵給 yosys

irsim.reason_en: GUI switch-level simulation. Timing is signed off by OpenSTA.
irsim.reason_zh: GUI 開關階層模擬；時序由 OpenSTA 簽核

kactus2.reason_en: IP-XACT GUI. Our IP contracts are the L-layer JSON.
kactus2.reason_zh: IP-XACT GUI；我們的 IP 契約走 L 層 JSON

kepler-formal.reason_en: An alternative formal engine. Step 5 uses SymbiYosys, which we have forked.
kepler-formal.reason_zh: 形式驗證替代品；step 5 用 SymbiYosys（已 fork）

klayout-vibeic.desc_en: KLayout, our build with the native svrfdrc DRC engine
klayout-vibeic.desc_zh: klayout（我們的 svrfdrc 原生 DRC 建置）

libman.reason_en: Liberty management. We read the PDK liberty directly.
libman.reason_zh: Liberty 管理；直接讀 PDK liberty

magic.desc_zh: 佈局編輯 + 寄生萃取

ngspyce.reason_en: Python bindings. We invoke ngspice directly.
ngspyce.reason_zh: Python 綁定；我們直接呼叫 ngspice

nvc.reason_en: VHDL simulator, same reason as ghdl and redundant with it.
nvc.reason_zh: VHDL 模擬器；同 ghdl，且重複

openems.reason_en: Electromagnetic field solving, not needed by the digital flow.
openems.reason_zh: 電磁場求解；數位流程不需要

openroad-librelane.reason_en: LibreLane flow wrapper. Our Phase 3 drives OpenROAD directly.
openroad-librelane.reason_zh: LibreLane 流程包裝；我們的 Phase 3 直接驅動 OpenROAD

openvaf.reason_en: Verilog-A compilation. The PDKs already provide compiled device models.
openvaf.reason_zh: Verilog-A 編譯；PDK 已提供編譯好的元件模型

osic-multitool.reason_en: IIC script collection, overlapping what our programs/ already does.
osic-multitool.reason_zh: IIC 腳本集；與我們的 programs/ 重疊

padring.reason_en: IO pad ring. Current designs have no pad frame; they are core-only.
padring.reason_zh: IO pad ring；目前設計無 pad frame（純核心）

palace.reason_en: Finite-element electromagnetics, outside the digital flow.
palace.reason_zh: 有限元電磁；不在數位流程

pyopus.reason_en: Circuit optimisation. Analog sizing is handled by the A2-A4 corner sweep.
pyopus.reason_zh: 電路最佳化；類比尺寸由 A2-A4 corner sweep 處理

qflow.reason_en: A complete alternative flow. We build on OpenROAD, and running both would create two sources of truth.
qflow.reason_zh: 完整替代流程；我們建在 OpenROAD 上，兩套並用會產生兩個真相來源

qucs-s.reason_en: GUI circuit simulation. Batch runs go through ngspice/Xyce, both of which we use.
qucs-s.reason_zh: GUI 電路模擬；批次走 ngspice/Xyce（已用）

rftoolkit.reason_en: RF design, outside the flow's scope.
rftoolkit.reason_zh: RF 設計；不在流程範圍

riscv-gnu-toolchain.reason_en: C cross-compilation. The flow compiles no software.
riscv-gnu-toolchain.reason_zh: 交叉編譯 C；流程不編譯軟體

spicebind.reason_en: SPICE bindings. We call the simulator directly.
spicebind.reason_zh: SPICE 綁定；直接呼叫模擬器

spike.reason_en: RISC-V ISA simulator. The flow runs no software.
spike.reason_zh: RISC-V ISA 模擬器；流程不跑軟體

surelog.reason_en: SystemVerilog parser, already covered by yosys's slang front end.
surelog.reason_zh: SV 解析器；yosys 的 slang 前端已覆蓋

surfer.reason_en: GUI waveforms, same reason as gaw3.

svck.reason_en: SystemVerilog lint. Ours runs through our own gates, because the criteria have to be measurable by the 63x8 matrix.
svck.reason_zh: SV lint；我們的 lint 由自家 gate 執行，判準要能被 63x8 矩陣量測

uv.reason_en: Python package manager. The image ships its dependencies pre-installed.
uv.reason_zh: Python 套件管理；映像已預裝依賴

vacask.reason_en: Another circuit simulator, already covered by ngspice and Xyce.
vacask.reason_zh: 又一個電路模擬器；ngspice + Xyce 已覆蓋

verible.reason_en: SystemVerilog lint/format, same reason as svck.

veryl.reason_en: Veryl language. The flow's input is not Veryl.
veryl.reason_zh: Veryl 語言；流程輸入不是 Veryl

xcircuit.reason_en: GUI schematics. The analog path uses xschem, which we do use.
xcircuit.reason_zh: GUI 電路圖；類比走 xschem（已用）

yices.desc_zh: SMT 求解器（由 sby 使用）

bender.reason_en: Hardware dependency management. Our dependencies are declared in the L-layer JSON.
bender.reason_zh: 硬體相依性管理；我們的相依由 L 層 JSON 宣告

icestorm.reason_en: Lattice FPGA bitstream. Our FPGA path is Intel Quartus.
icestorm.reason_zh: Lattice FPGA 位元流；我們的 FPGA 路徑是 Intel Quartus

nextpnr.reason_en: FPGA place and route, same reason as icestorm.

sv2v.reason_en: SystemVerilog to Verilog conversion. yosys reads SystemVerilog directly.
sv2v.reason_zh: SV→Verilog 轉換；yosys 直接吃 SystemVerilog

trilinos.reason_en: A numerical library (a Xyce dependency), not a standalone tool.
trilinos.reason_zh: 數值程式庫（Xyce 的相依），非獨立工具

yosys_eqy.reason_en: Equivalence checking. We use yosys equiv, which we do ship.
yosys_eqy.reason_zh: 等價驗證；我們用 yosys equiv（已用）

yosys_mcy.reason_en: Mutation coverage. Our mutation testing is the in-house gate_cli_mutation_probe.
yosys_mcy.reason_zh: 突變覆蓋率；我們的突變測試是自建的 gate_cli_mutation_probe
